items.answer_raw: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand.

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ
items.answer_raw: Behold, the two kings did not stand before him, and how shall we stand?

items.body_raw: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וַיַּעֲבֵר רוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה עַל־הָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And God remembered Noah, and he caused a great wind to pass over the earth.

items.body_raw: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא
items.answer_raw: And he and I dreamed a dream in one night.

items.body_raw: וְאַבְרָם הֶאֱמִין בַּיהוָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לּוֹ צְדָקָה
items.answer_raw: And Abraham trusted in Yahweh, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
Give us this land and do not send us over the river.
Forsake not Wisdom: love her, that she may keep thee.

items.body_raw: ואתם אל־תעמדו רדפו אחרי איביכם כי נתנם יהוה אלהיכם בידכם
items.answer_raw: Do not ye stand: pursue after your enemies, for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.

items.body_raw: Pass not the river, lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
Our land shall not be tilled, for our enemies shall stand in the midst-of-her.
items.answer_raw: לֹא תֵעָבֵד אַרְצֵנוּ כִּי יַעַמְדוּ אֹיְבֵינוּ בְּקִרְבָּהּ

items.body_raw: And he made to pass his children in the fire.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת־בָּנָיו בָּאֵשׁ (or יְלָדָיו for בָּנָיו)

items.body_raw: Our feet shall stand in thy (f.) gates (O) Jerusalem.
My father and my mother have forsaken me.
